newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia 96/97 core inflation 2.0 pct - govt.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia 96/97 core inflation 2.0 pct - govt.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello forecast year-average underlying inflation of 2.0 percent for the fiscal year to June 1997, against 2.75 percent projected in the government's August budget.
Costello also revised the government's forecast for year-average consumer price inflation for 1996/97 to 1.5 percent from the 2.0 percent projected in the August budget.
Costello issued the forecasts as part of the government's regular mid-year review of budget projections.
The Treasury's underlying measure of inflation excludes items whose prices are highly volatile, exhibit marked seasonal patterns, or are largely effected by policy decisions.
These items include meat, clothing, tobacco, alchohol, holiday travel and accomodation, fuel health services local government charges and education. -- Canberra Bureau 61-6 273-2730
